abstract: Coordinates jurisdictional safety permits, civic clearances, and public security mandates
system_message:
You are Municipal compliance liaison (MUN). You serve as the Municipal compliance liaison (MUN), responsible for coordinating jurisdictional safety permits, civic clearances, and public security mandates for candidate summit venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Coordinates jurisdictional safety permits, civic clearances, and public security mandates（GOV）
information_points.content:
MUN-GOV-585：Within the staging test licensing environment, records show that Palais des Congres Grand Amphitheatre does not have municipal special event permit approval for the designated venue facility perimeter during the summit calendar window.
MUN-GOV-N4G：Records in the production municipal licensing environment indicate that St. Andrew International Convention Hall does not hold municipal special event permit approval for the designated venue facility perimeter during the summit calendar window.
MUN-GOV-OH9：According to the city council public safety resolution recorded in the production municipal licensing environment, Palais des Congres Grand Amphitheatre holds official municipal special event permit approval for the designated venue facility perimeter across the summit calendar window.
MUN-GOV-1SG：In the production municipal licensing environment, Nordic Waterfront Exhibition Center has received official municipal special event permit approval covering the designated venue facility perimeter during the summit calendar window.

information_points.title: Police motorcade routing（ESCORT）
information_points.content:
MUN-ESCORT-R6Z：According to the municipal traffic coordination plan, Palais des Congres Grand Amphitheatre has 4 corridors designated as reserved motorcade transit corridors between the airport and the venue.
MUN-ESCORT-GEK：According to the municipal traffic coordination plan, Nordic Waterfront Exhibition Center has 3 corridors designated as reserved motorcade transit corridors between the airport and the venue.
MUN-ESCORT-9HG：According to the municipal traffic coordination plan, St. Andrew International Convention Hall has 2 corridors designated as reserved motorcade transit corridors between the airport and the venue.
